children: Shuttle Pharmaceuticals postponed its special meeting to September 9, 2026 and set a proxy receipt deadline of 11:59 p.m. ET on September 8, 2026.
Special Meeting moved from Sept. 3, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. ET to Sept. 9, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. ET to allow additional proxy solicitation.
Votes must be received by 11:59 p.m. ET on Sept. 8, 2026 to be counted for the reconvened meeting.
Postponement gives stockholders more time to consider proposals, including amended Milestone Events disclosed in the Sept. 1, 2026 Form 8-K.
Previously submitted valid proxies remain valid for the reconvened meeting unless properly changed or revoked before voting.
